newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end at highs, eye April inflation.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end at highs, eye April inflation.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed stronger on Tuesday, setting another closing high although off intraday price levels, dealers said.
Some signs of tiredness began to set in, and dealers said a correction may be initiated by Wednesday's April inflation data, seen falling from 2.2 percent in March to below two percent.
The general index rose 3.69 points, 0.68 percent, 548.00 and the Ibex-35 added 40.50 points, 0.64 percent, to 6,324.24.
Telefonica came off initial highs after Monday's announcement of a 15.7 percent rise in first quarter results, adding 15 pesetas to 4,070.
Banesto ended lower, shedding 15 pesetas to 1,660 after a long bull run.
"This afternoon we saw more paper in the market and more people are expecting a technical pull-back in the short term," said one.
Inflation, if below two percent, may see the bourse open higher, falling off later as traders start to take profits.
But on a longer time horizon sentiment is positive, dealers said.
